description: Sydney's death leaves Craig grieving while Cooper and Lexi enter the Melrose orbit, Amanda builds a new agency, and Michael, Megan, Peter, Taylor, Kyle, Billy and Samantha keep rearranging their alliances. Christine's arrival drives the season toward deception, accidental death and increasingly desperate cover-ups.

s06e01.description: Craig blames Samantha for the crash that killed Sydney and his father, while a new surgeon arrives at Wilshire and unsettles Michael.

s06e02.description: Cooper moves into Matt's old apartment and begins probing Melrose history, particularly Michael's complicated past with Kimberly.

s06e03.description: Taylor's fake pregnancy starts collapsing, so she turns to Michael with an outrageous plan to make the deception physically real.

s06e04.description: Samantha admits exposing Billy and Amanda's plan for a new agency, while Craig finally accepts that his professional fight is lost.

s06e05.description: Sydney's father visits grieving Craig, while Amanda launches Amanda Woodward Advertising with Eric as her financial backer.

s06e06.description: Peter discovers Cooper once treated Kimberly after her accident, connecting the new doctor directly to Michael's most dangerous history.

s06e07.description: Lexi freezes Cooper's assets, and Cooper wrongly assumes Michael betrayed the financial secrets he was trying to hide.

s06e08.description: Peter openly commits to Lexi, while Jennifer helps Craig market the Mancini Glove and find a new direction after Sydney.

s06e09.description: Megan follows Cooper after his release and uncovers evidence that Kimberly's mother, not Cooper, targeted Michael.

s06e10.description: Cooper keeps vigil beside comatose Megan, while Michael's jealousy turns the situation into an uncomfortable echo of Kimberly.

s06e11.description: Billy and Samantha honeymoon in Hawaii as Connie enters Amanda's agency and quickly decides Los Angeles suits her schemes.

s06e12.description: Peter rescues Lexi after an accident, then discovers that her driving may have seriously injured a homeless man.

s06e13.description: Cooper quietly interferes with Michael's pursuit of Megan, while Jennifer persuades Cooper to abandon his lawsuit against Michael.

s06e14.description: Taylor hides the jazz club's missing money and takes Kyle gambling in Las Vegas in a desperate attempt to repair the debt.

s06e15.description: Billy and Kyle push rescuers to search for missing Amanda and Samantha after an accident leaves their fate uncertain.

s06e16.description: Cooper and Megan begin dating, Michael pursues Amber, and Bob's interest in Lexi creates fresh trouble for Peter.

s06e17.description: Lexi's father openly rejects Peter, while Jennifer learns enough about Craig's illegal shortcuts to become a threat he cannot ignore.

s06e18.description: Michael and Jennifer's formidable mother arrives, and Jennifer's admission about Craig instantly turns the family visit into an interrogation.

s06e19-20.description: Kyle and Amanda visit his former girlfriend in Santa Fe, but Christine's arrival in Los Angeles threatens their approaching wedding. Christine's presence continues disrupting Amanda and Kyle's wedding plans as old loyalties and new manipulation collide.

s06e21.description: Lexi moves in with Cooper and continues blaming Peter for her father's death despite evidence pointing elsewhere.

s06e22.description: Peter is unknowingly drawn into a scheme against Amanda and Kyle when Christine fakes suicidal behavior and lands in psychiatric care.

s06e23.description: Nick and Taylor accidentally kill Christine and stage her body on railroad tracks to make the death appear self-inflicted.

s06e24.description: Billy and Samantha wrestle with guilt over their separate affairs, while Jeff pressures Samantha to choose him over her marriage.

s06e25.description: Michael considers desperate measures to save his failing clinic until Megan intervenes and forces him to reconsider.

s06e26-27.description: Jennifer reacts to Samantha and Billy's reconciliation by trying to revive the attraction between Samantha and Jeff. Cooper and Megan travel to Philadelphia for his career opportunity, where a senior doctor places Megan in a coercive situation.
